subject: Insurance
examFormat: Two papers taken at one sitting. Paper 1 has 50 compulsory multiple-choice questions to be answered in 50 minutes for 50 marks. Paper 2 (2 hours, 80 marks) has Section A, a compulsory case study of 200-250 words with a compulsory question on it (20 marks), and Section B, six essay questions of which candidates answer four (15 marks each).

topics.name: Introduction to Insurance
objectives: Explain the meaning of insurance
Describe the historical development of insurance
Identify the parties to and essential features of an insurance contract
Explain risks, their effect on society and their classification, and distinguish insurable from un-insurable risks
Explain the meaning and types of hazards
State the primary and secondary functions of insurance
State the benefits of insurance
Explain perils and distinguish among perils, risks and hazards
topics.content: Meaning. Historical development: pre- and post-independence era and legislations. Insurance contracts: parties to an insurance contract and essential features of an insurance contract. Risks: meaning, effect of risks on the society, classification of risks, insurable and un-insurable risks. Hazards: meaning and types. Functions of insurance: primary and secondary functions. Benefits of insurance. Perils: meaning and differences among perils, risks and hazards.

subtopics.name: Insurable Interest
objectives: Explain the meaning and essential features of insurable interest
Apply insurable interest in life assurance and property insurance

subtopics.name: Utmost Good Faith
objectives: Explain the meaning of utmost good faith
State the insured's and insurer's duty of disclosure
State the breaches and their effects

subtopics.name: Proximate Cause
objectives: Explain the meaning of proximate cause
Apply proximate cause on claims

subtopics.name: Indemnity
objectives: Explain the meaning of indemnity
State the methods of providing indemnity by the insurer
Apply indemnity in property and liability insurance

subtopics.name: Subrogation
objectives: Explain the meaning of subrogation
State the insurer's right under subrogation
State the insured's duty under subrogation

subtopics.name: Contribution
objectives: Explain the meaning of contribution
Apply contribution
State the conditions necessary for contribution

subtopics.name: Proposal Forms
objectives: Explain the meaning of proposal forms
State the functions and uses of proposal forms
Identify contracts where proposal forms are used

subtopics.name: Cover Notes
objectives: Explain the meaning of cover notes
State the contents of cover notes
State the functions and uses of cover notes
Identify contracts where cover notes are issued

subtopics.name: Certificate of Insurance
objectives: Explain the meaning of a certificate of insurance
Describe the certificate of insurance in motor, marine and employer's liability insurance

subtopics.name: Policy
objectives: Explain the meaning of a policy
State the component parts of a policy
Identify the parties to a policy

subtopics.name: Re-insurance
objectives: Explain the meaning of re-insurance
Identify its forms (facultative and treaty)
State its functions and uses

subtopics.name: Insurance Renewals
objectives: Explain the meaning of a renewal notice
Describe the renewal procedure
State the legal status of a renewal notice
Explain No Claim Discount (NCD): meaning and uses
Explain Long Term Agreement (LTA): meaning and uses

subtopics.name: Insurance Claims
objectives: Explain the meaning of claims
Describe the claim procedure: notification, documentation (claim forms), investigation, discharge voucher and payment
State the duties of the insured and the underwriter in claims
State the functions of loss assessors and loss adjusters

subtopics.name: Insurance Premium
objectives: Explain the meaning of premium
State the factors to be considered when determining a premium
State the factors responsible for loading premium
Explain return premium (partial and full) and the reasons for returning premium

subtopics.name: Motor Insurance
objectives: Explain the meaning of motor insurance
Identify the types of policies: private car, commercial vehicle, motorcycle, agricultural and forestry vehicle, and special types (fork lifts, tractors, caterpillars)
Explain the scope of cover: Act only, third party only, third party, fire and theft, and comprehensive
Explain the ECOWAS Brown Card: meaning and uses

subtopics.name: Fire Insurance
objectives: Explain the meaning of fire insurance
Describe the standard fire policy cover
Identify special perils: earthquake, flood, riot and strike
Identify the properties covered: building and its contents, machinery and plant, stocks
Identify the buyers of fire insurance: individuals, corporate bodies and government agencies

subtopics.name: Theft Insurance and Burglary Insurance
objectives: Explain the meaning of theft and burglary insurance
Identify the properties covered: household properties, stocks, machinery and plants
Describe theft and burglary insurance in business and private premises
Distinguish between theft insurance and burglary insurance

subtopics.name: Money Insurance
objectives: Explain the meaning of money insurance
State what constitutes money (cash, cheque, postal order)
Identify the types of cover available: in transit only, in safe or strong room after business hours, in custody of a staff e.g. cashier

subtopics.name: Fidelity Guarantee Insurance
objectives: Explain the meaning of fidelity guarantee insurance
Identify the types of policies: named policy, position policy and blanket policy
Explain the meaning of a bond
Distinguish between commercial guarantee and bonds

subtopics.name: Engineering Insurance
objectives: Explain the meaning of engineering insurance
Identify the types: boiler, explosion and computer all risks
State the scope of engineering insurance: material damage and liability cover

subtopics.name: Marine Insurance
objectives: Explain the meaning of marine insurance
Identify marine perils
Identify the types of cover: hull policy, cargo policy and freight policy

subtopics.name: Aviation Insurance
objectives: Explain the meaning of aviation insurance
Identify the types of aviation policy: hull, cargo, freight, liability arising from aircraft operation, and liability to passengers and non-passengers
Identify aviation risks and the factors affecting them
State the international regulations of aviation insurance: Montreal Convention, Hague Rule and Warsaw Convention

subtopics.name: Employer's Liability Insurance
objectives: Explain the meaning of employer's liability insurance
Describe the policy covered (employees' compensation policy)
State the level of benefits payable
Identify the perils covered

subtopics.name: Public Liability Insurance
objectives: Explain the meaning of public liability insurance
Identify the types: personal liability policy and product liability policy

subtopics.name: Professional Indemnity Insurance
objectives: Explain the meaning of professional indemnity
Identify the professionals that require professional indemnity: doctors, lawyers, insurance brokers, accountants and architects

subtopics.name: Business Interruption Insurance
objectives: Explain the meaning of business interruption insurance (consequential loss)
Identify the causes of business interruption: machinery breakdown and fire incident

subtopics.name: Personal Accident Insurance
objectives: Explain the meaning of personal accident insurance
Identify the risks covered: death, bodily injury, permanent disability, total temporary disability and medical expenses
Identify the forms of personal accident insurance (personal and group)
State the benefits (death, bodily injury and medical expenses)
Identify the buyers of personal and group accident policies

topics.name: Insurance Market (Operators)
objectives: Explain the meaning of the insurance market
Identify the market operators: insurance companies, reinsurance companies and insurance intermediaries (brokers and agents)
Identify insurance buyers: individual and private, corporate and public institutions
Identify insurance sellers: insurance companies and re-insurance companies
Identify supporting services: assessors and loss adjusters

topics.name: Insurance Regulator
objectives: State the meaning, role/functions, purpose and membership of NIA, NCRIB, ILAN, NAICOM and CIIN
topics.content: Bodies covered: Nigerian Insurance Association (NIA), Nigerian Council of Registered Insurance Brokers (NCRIB), Institute of Loss Adjusters of Nigeria (ILAN), National Insurance Commission (NAICOM) and Chartered Insurance Institute of Nigeria (CIIN). For each: meaning, role/functions, purpose and membership.

topics.name: Common Insurance Terminologies
objectives: Explain the meaning of hazards, perils, concealment, disclosure, days of grace, ex-gratia payment, extra-premium, endorsement, excepted perils, subject matter of insurance, under insurance, return premium, surrender value and cover note
